subject: english
stem: Students who slept longer reported better focus, but sleep was not assigned or controlled. Which wording fits?
options: No relation appeared in the reports.
Longer sleep was associated with better reported focus.
Longer sleep proved it causes perfect focus.
Focus caused every student to sleep.

optionRationales.reason: No relation appeared in the reports.：文本說 better focus。
Longer sleep was associated with better reported focus.：觀察自報資料適合 associated with。
Longer sleep proved it causes perfect focus.：因果與 perfect 過度。
Focus caused every student to sleep.：方向無證據。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「結論的每個範圍詞與因果強度都不超過文中方法和結果」可推出 Longer sleep was associated with better reported focus.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Longer sleep was associated with better reported focus. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
